description: Two white rooks doubled on the a-file: the rook on a3 attacks the black pawn on a7 directly and the rook on a1 attacks it through the front rook, recorded as a battery.
decisions: A battery is two friendly pieces that move along the same kind of line standing on one line; the back piece's reach continues through the front piece and is recorded as an attack of kind battery with the front piece's square as 'through'.
The back piece's direct attack on the front piece is an ordinary defence, kind direct.
A battery line ends at the first piece beyond the front piece, inclusive: the pawn on a7 is attacked, a8 beyond it is not.
Only one intervening piece is ever looked through, so a line with two pieces of any kind on it reaches nothing beyond the second.

assertions.note: The back rook defends the front rook.
The black king on h8 does not reach a7: the pawn is undefended.
The back rook also defends the white king along the first rank.
